The aromatic region (125.4 to 138.0 ppm) suggests a benzene ring. I will now use the proton NMR data to further elucidate the structure.

The 1H NMR data shows:
- 2.08 ppm (s, 6H): likely two equivalent methyl groups
- 2.36 ppm (s, 5H): possibly a methylene group adjacent to a nitrogen or oxygen
- 2.68 ppm (s, 6H): another set of equivalent methyl groups
- 6.58 ppm (s, 2H): likely aromatic protons
- 6.86 - 6.94 ppm (m, 4H): aromatic protons
- 7.06 ppm (ddd, 2H): aromatic protons
- 7.15 ppm (dq, 2H): aromatic protons

The IR data indicates the presence of C-H (3065, 3019, 2928, 2853 cm-1), C=O (1651 cm-1), and aromatic C=C (1461 cm-1) stretches.

Based on this information, the compound likely contains a benzene ring, a carbonyl group, and several methyl groups. The molecular formula C22H28N2O2 suggests the presence of nitrogen, possibly in an amide or amine group. I will now attempt to construct a possible structure and verify it using the molecular formula.
